title: Moneyview IPO Details
intro:
Moneyview IPO is a book build issue of ₹1,091.68 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 22.06 crore shares aggregating to ₹750.00 crores and offer for sale of 10.05 crore shares aggregating to ₹341.68 crores.

Moneyview IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 24, 2026 and will close on Sep 28, 2026. The allotment for the Moneyview IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 29, 2026. Moneyview IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Oct 1, 2026.

Moneyview IPO is set issue price band at ₹32 to ₹34 per share. The lot size for an application is 441 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,994 (441 shares) (based on upper price).

Axis Capital Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Moneyview IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2014, Moneyview Ltd. is a fintech company incorporated in India that provides digital financial services through its mobile platform. The company focuses on offering accessible and technology-driven financial solutions to individuals. The company operates a digital platform that provides personal loans, credit tracking, and financial management services. It uses data analytics and technology to assess creditworthiness and deliver quick loan approvals to customers.

The company's platform functions as a two-sided network, connecting their users seeking financial products with banks, NBFCs, insurers, and other financial institutions offering such products. As of June 30, 2026, they had 140.28 million Registered Users and 48 Financial Partners integrated into the network. They expanded offerings across multiple product categories, including insurance, credit cards, digital gold, payments, and earned wage access.

The technology and AI led operating model enables them to offer a fully unassisted, seamless user journey, ensuring accessibility, scalability, and cost efficiency. As of June 30, 2026, more than 50% of workforce was engaged in technology and data roles, reflecting their sustained investment in building in-house capabilities.
The company operate a capital-efficient model supported by deep technical integrations with 48 Financial Partners, enabling seamless distribution of our full suite of financial products.
As of June 30, 2026, the total workforce comprised 1,933 personnel, including 798 permanent employees and 1,135 contract employees.
strengths: Large, growing and sticky user base with a flywheel effect for growth
Data-driven approach for user segmentation and risk assessment
Technological and AI capabilities enabling scalable and efficient growth
Capital-light model with a diversified network of capital partners
Experienced management team with a track record of building and managing successful businesses

faqs.question: How to apply in Moneyview IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Moneyview IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Moneyview IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Moneyview IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Moneyview IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Moneyview IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Moneyview IPO opens on Thu, Sep 24, 2026 and closes on Mon, Sep 28, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Moneyview IPO?
faqs.answer: Moneyview IPO lot size is 441 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,994 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Moneyview IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Moneyview IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Moneyview IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Moneyview IPO will be done on Tuesday, September 29, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Wed, Sep 30, 2026 . Check the Moneyview IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Moneyview IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Moneyview IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Thu, Oct 1, 2026 .
